issue.title: [sonic-cfg]: Vlan names from the minigraph could be incompatible with SONiC Vlan interfaces naming schema

failure.body:
SONiC supports Vlan interface names in format "Vlan"+dot1Q tag.
So, usually SONiC vlan names are: Vlan1 (for vlan tag 1), Vlan10 (for vlan tag 10) and so on.
Currently sonic-cfg takes a Vlan interface names from the minigraph VlanInterface["Name"] field. But it can contains a vlan name in incompatible format, like "Computers".
So right way to create a vlan name is to use "Vlan" + VlanInterface['Tag"].

resolution.title: Fix VLAN_INTERFACE attach issue upon vlan id-name mismatch
resolution.description:
**- What I did**
Together with #695, this will fix #1003.

**- How I did it**
When a Vlan has vlan name different with "Vlan"+id, it will be recorded as an alias. And when DPG is parsing, both "Vlan"+id and alias will be checked for "AttachTo" field.
